title: Two-Payment Settlement Pricing Worksheet: Offer Percentage and Settlement Amount
content:
# Two-Payment Settlement — Pricing Worksheet

This worksheet of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements prices a Two-Payment Settlement offer that Ridgeline extends on its own authority: it fixes the Two-Payment offer percentage and the Two-Payment settlement amount.

## Floors by placement stage

The Two-Payment authority floor for the account's current placement stage is 100.0 for Early-Out Placement, 75.0 for Primary Placement, 60.0 for Secondary Placement, 50.0 for Tertiary Placement, 40.0 for Warehouse Placement and 80.0 for Legal Review Placement, and the Two-Payment approval floor for the same stages is 100.0, 55.0, 45.0, 35.0, 25.0 and 65.0 in that order.

| Placement stage (as the placed account shows it) | Two-Payment authority floor | Two-Payment approval floor |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 100.0 | 100.0 |
| Primary Placement | 75.0 | 55.0 |
| Secondary Placement | 60.0 | 45.0 |
| Tertiary Placement | 50.0 | 35.0 |
| Warehouse Placement | 40.0 | 25.0 |
| Legal Review Placement | 80.0 | 65.0 |

## Same-client bundle

Where the consumer holds at least two accounts placed under the account's client agreement and every one of them is open in validation period, active, arranged or hardship hold status, the Two-Payment offer is part of a same-client bundle: it carries the bundle flag set to true and the Two-Payment authority floor is lowered by the Two-Payment bundle reduction of 2.0 percentage points; where any account placed under that agreement is in dispute hold, still only placed, or closed as paid in full, settled in full or returned to the client, or fewer than two accounts are placed under it, the bundle flag is false and nothing is lowered.

A Two-Payment offer may stand in one bundle with Three-Payment offers on the consumer's other accounts under the same client agreement, every offer of the bundle being dated the same offer date.

## Offer percentage

The Two-Payment offer percentage is the Two-Payment authority floor less any same-client bundle reduction, never set below the Two-Payment approval floor for the stage.

The Two-Payment offer percentage is worked out in this order: first the Two-Payment authority floor for the stage is taken, then the same-client bundle reduction and every Two-Payment reduction that applies are added together and subtracted from it once, and only then is that figure compared with the Two-Payment approval floor for the stage, the higher of the two being the Two-Payment offer percentage.

The Two-Payment offer percentage is carried to one decimal place and the settlement amount is computed from it.

## Settlement amount and limits

The Two-Payment settlement amount is the account's balance due on the offer date times the Two-Payment offer percentage divided by 100, rounded up to the next whole dollar only once at the end; an amount below 100.00 dollars is never offered under this rule.

A Two-Payment offer under this rule never relies on a client approval: it is extended only where the account's balance due is no more than 25,000.00 dollars and the balance due less the settlement amount is no more than 10,000.00 dollars, and it carries no approval request.

## Hypothetical worked examples

| Hypothetical inputs | Offer percentage | Amount before rounding | Settlement amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secondary Placement, no bundle, balance due 1234.56 dollars | 60.0 | 740.736 | 741.00 dollars |
| Secondary Placement, bundle of two open accounts, balance due 1234.56 dollars | 60.0 less 2.0, that is 58.0 | 716.0448 | 717.00 dollars |
| Warehouse Placement, no bundle, balance due 200.00 dollars | 40.0 | 80.00 | below 100.00 dollars, not offered under this rule |

In the first row the balance less the settlement amount is 493.56 dollars, within the 10,000.00-dollar limit.
